title: Text Renderer
description: Renders sharp, scalable typography with alignment, line wrapping, outlines, and drop shadows. Use Text Renderer for dialogue, score counters, labels, and floating combat text.

blocks.content: The **Text Renderer** component draws crisp text in both **World** and **User Interface** layers. When you import a **.ttf** or **.otf** font into the **Assets** panel, the editor automatically converts it into a Multi-channel Signed Distance Field (MSDF) font so your text stays sharp at any font size or camera zoom.

items.title: Crisp MSDF Fonts
items.desc: Import **.ttf** or **.otf** fonts that scale cleanly without pixelation.

items.title: Flexible Layout
items.desc: Control horizontal and vertical alignment, line spacing, character spacing, and overflow.

items.title: Outline & Shadow
items.desc: Add stroke outlines and configurable drop shadows for readable HUD text.

items.title: Auto Line Sizing
items.desc: Automatically expands the entity's transform height to fit wrapped lines.

items: Select an entity in the [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy) or [Scene Viewport](interface/scene_viewport).
In the [Property Inspector](interface/property_inspector), click **Add Component...** under **Actions** and choose **Text Renderer**.
Type your content into the **Text** field.
To use a custom font, import a **.ttf** or **.otf** file into the **Assets** panel, right-click the font asset, and click **Apply to TextRenderer**.

blocks.message: Right-click a layer in the **Scene Hierarchy**, hover over **Add Entity** (or **Add UI Element**), and click **Text** (or **UI Text**) to create a text entity directly.

blocks.content: Create a centered score counter with an outline and drop shadow so it remains readable over any background.

items: In the [Scene Hierarchy](interface/scene_hierarchy), right-click a **User Interface** layer, hover over **Add UI Element**, and click **UI Text**.
In the **Text Renderer** section, set **Text** to **0000** and **Font Size** to **36**.
Set **Outline** width (**W**) to **0.25** and pick a dark outline color.
Check **Drop Shadow** and set **Offset** to **X: 2**, **Y: -2** and **Blur** to **4**.
